name: Signature Robe (Draknara)
description: a floor-length ceremonial spirit-walker robe of {{PRIMARY}} woven cloth and soft hide, painted ochre spirals and {{ACCENT_SOFT}} beadwork on the chest and sleeves, wide fringed sleeves, a mantle of feathers and painted hide, an open front over a fitted {{PRIMARY}} bodice and long slit skirt, a wide {{METAL}} belt hung with bone and bead talismans, a hem of long swinging fringe
notes: Ceremonial signature robe in her element and class, worn in her Robe scene.
